postCreateCmd: sh -c 'MAIN=$(git worktree list | grep "[main]" | head -1 | cut -f1 -d" "); [ -z "$MAIN" ] && exit 0; for f in .env .env.local .env.production .env.staging .env.db; do [ -f "$MAIN/$f" ] && rm -f "$f" && ln -sfn "$MAIN/$f" "$f"; done; echo "Linked .env files from $MAIN"'

sh -c 'MAIN=$(git worktree list | grep "[main]" | head -1 | cut -f1 -d" "); [ -z "$MAIN" ] && exit 0; for d in node_modules; do if [ -d "$MAIN/$d" ]; then rm -rf "$d" && ln -sfn "$MAIN/$d" "$d" && echo "[branchlet] Symlinked $d/ from $MAIN"; fi; done; echo "[branchlet] Shared dir linking complete"'
